verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents overlay networks that let instances on different machines on the same physical LAN share a private virtual LAN, and has a multi-node torch/NCCL training guide. Provisioning is self-serve: sign up, add credit, then search for multi-GPU offers via the CLI or API, with no sales contact. There is no evidence of a fast interconnect such as InfiniBand or RDMA, multi-node is limited to machines on the same LAN, and community reports of bandwidth that differs from what is listed lower confidence. Missing for 10: documented high-speed interconnect specs (InfiniBand, RDMA, NVLink across nodes), a one-step cluster provisioning workflow, and independent hands-on confirmation of multi-node training performance.
